name: CITIC Metal Co., Ltd
summary: CITIC Metal Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, trades in metals and mineral products in China and internationally. The company offers ferrous and non-ferrous metals; iron ore; steel plates, including hot and cold rolled steel sheets, zinc plated steel sheets, and moderately thick steel plates; steel strips and tubular steel products; cooper products, such as copper concentrate, electrolytic copper, blister copper, and copper cathodes; niobium; aluminum products comprising electrolytic aluminum, aluminum oxide, bauxite, and aluminum bars; and special minerals, which include chrome ores, manganese ores, ferrochromium, and silicomanganese.
